collection.description: A villager wonders whether the island protects its people or keeps them from leaving.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A villager wonders whether the island protects its people or prevents them from leaving.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They believe courage may create possibilities where none existed.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: They consider reefs, weather, and geography as barriers.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They ask whether belonging and freedom can coexist.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: They propose mapping the shoreline before drawing conclusions.

r1.name: Resolution 1
r1.text: The villager discovers a plausible ordinary cause but may still value the experience for personal reasons.

r3.text: Another villager interprets the same evidence differently. Their exchange can deepen respect, cause a mild argument, or inspire a shared project.
